links.note: There was introduces the man; Greek introduces him with behold.
That way renders the genitive of that place.
Went on renders added in a speech construction.
Until renders the temporal phrase in which.
Came before him renders the compound verb arrived.
Were found renders became or proved.
Earned interest freely renders collected it with interest.
More supplies the object of given.
The source repeats the participant already described.
His is implicit in the article.
The object of bring is implicit.
Them supplies the implied surface beneath Jesus.
Your supplies the contextual possessor of peace.
Another renders a second occurrence of stone.
Hung on every word renders hung on him while listening.
